title: Early cancer risk from longitudinal Barrett biopsies: sequence matching with copy-number fusion
idea: Use the longitudinal surveillance cohort to train a deep survival model on the sequence of slide-level tissue representations, integrating shallow whole-genome copy-number features. This can directly predict progression to high-grade dysplasia/cancer and reveal when histology alone is not enough.
design: Pool five tile-level embedding sets per biopsy to obtain one biopsy vector, then apply a temporal cross-attention (Transformer) over biopsy sequences per patient, concatenated with CNV segment-features. Train Cox coefficients on progression time with strict cross-val (LOSO or patient-group CV). Report c-index, DCA, and Kaplan–Meier separation.
why_this_data: SWGCohort is unique: it has high repetition of Barrett surveillance with a molecular phenotype and outcome labels, allowing sequence modelling with a short-time-step and hard pathology—not just cross-sectional survival.

title: Slide-to-Test: Contrastive stance from ERIN reports to generate weak surveillance labels
idea: Match ERIN’s H&E WSIs to traceable free-text pathology reports in a contrastive learning scheme, using LLM-extracted key phrases as text-side anchors. This can produce a slide-level representation tuned to surveillance wording applied to Barrett-grade detection.
design: Use the local LLM jury to parse each report into target attributes (e.g., 'dysplasia', 'glandular', 'atypia'), produce text encodings, slide encodings from the mean-pooled WIL array., train a contrastive projector (Image/Text). Then use the resulting embedding to classify report-level label from ERIN; evaluate in held-out ERIN and transfer to SWGCohort to predict pathologist grade.
why_this_data: The free-text reports plus images in the same local cohort (ERIN) + TCGA text make a naturally bilingual slide-report vocabulary without needing hand-annotated slide classifications; no other cohort has such a broad survey of 7k reports.

title: Image-based detection of whole-genome doubling in esophageal chinese from H&E
description: Demonstrate can be inferred purely from H&E slides using OCCAMS whole-genomic labelled data, and validate at clinical genomic triage for Barrett’s progression in SWCohort.
design: Train attention-based multiple-instance MIL on OCCAMS WGD / TP53 labels using all five embedding sets + dropout to predict whether WGD present; evaluate in 10-fold CV. Then apply model to SWCohort and compare derived WGD-estimate to shallow CNV copy number (e.g., GC-burden void).
why_this_unusual: OCCAMS is the only cohort with full WGS plus resection-grade H&E; SWCohort has shallow CN to allow an independent, non-outcome-based biological correlation and error analysis.
compute: 100 H200 GPU-hours for MIL WGD training

title: Genomically informed tumor architecture: which latent histo-picture segment genes
description: Decompose H&E tile embeddings of adenocarcinomas into clusters of morphological clones, then correlate abundances with copy-number events and expression pathways from TCGA and OCCAMS.
design: Perform unsupervised clustering on each slide-treasure pool (per each foundation model), create cell-fraction exponentials (topic) per specimen. Then regress clatal fractions against genomic PCovs, TP53, PPmt, ploidy; also do GSVA pathways pan-cancer cross-cohort with expression; report pathway-enrichment overlap across levers.
why: Figuring connectomics cross-scale: small-segment latent pathology to molecular and genomic copy— not possible with any other trio of cohorts.
compute: CPU-large for clustering in memory, 30 H200 GPU-hours for MADs

title: Detection: uncertainty from five foundation models turns into a trust signal for the clinician
description: Use these five foundation models as sort-of an *ensemble of tumor*; measure pathologist-level disagreement among Beirut of dysplastic blocks. Predict which VHS call is most ‘in-between’.
design: For each WSI trained with a lightweight MIL one vector per tumor, ensemble CE to obtain disagreements and risk AUCs. SWCohort labels=grade; then test epense that high disagreement regions on SWGCohort are the factories of overt change to progression; derive mislabelling AUC.
why_unique: A roster of 5 distinct precomputed features is rare; attention-based consensus means you can directly calibrate the shape of low-confidence histology.
compute: cpu 10 h + 200 GPU-hours from tuning small model each

title: Doctor-speak: the text signature of biopsy when images fail
description: Juxtapose longitudinal text alone in Barrett’s specialist database (13k reports) with slide-stage survival of SWCohort; find NLPs of report-keywords that add predictive jump to image-only model.
design: Build a transformer over sentence-borrowed keywords from Barrett text-only (TM-mean of report-composed). Then merge with slide embeddings derived from image side from SWCohort (BRPP-s). Use Cox regressions with text tokens vs image representations, and do level-1 stage: text-only, image-only, hybrid. Perform likelihood and C-index on progression.
why_this_unique: Nearly all imaging cohorts lack a text historian; the Barrett’s specialist 13k longitudinal reports offer a large-only source to anchor a “text-only latent” that can be fused with ERIN to the same institution.
compute: CPU/GPU hours ~200 H200 for text memo median token tuning

title: Live-on 9,517 report–slide pairs: transfer of pathology language–slide pre-training to esophageal area
description: Use the large TCGA pan-cancer report+slide set (with all endable WSI and machine reports) to fine-tune a projection between path foundation-features and LLM token space: a domain-adaptive “path decoder” of text. Then left it transfer to EURIN / TCGA-ESCA for transfer the between GI/adeno.
design: Extract15* all slides with the given embeddings; train a 0-layer logistic projector from image embedding to a 512-d text embedding (using report paraphr // encoder). Then test cross-cop-out: on training on TCGA-STAD/ ACCA to ERIN, or on ERIN to SWC resolution; measure retrieval (TLN) agreement + a dysprofile AUC.
why: This is one of the few feasible cases to scope generalist foundation model against broad pan GI, while keeping both image report language common across organs.

title: Composite of whole-genome doubling and ploidy and histology shapea: from foundation to freeOS
description: Build a diagnos of pathology where tumour content of morphological latent features is (fully mechanistic) that also achieves high electron microscopy sex, with direct assessment on treatment.
design: Train a basic MIL-NN with a “ability split” to predict transformation (WGD) plus survival, using: H&E embeddings + stage & reported. To measure from SHAP which latent drives WGD-author. Run feature attribution to OCCAMS CNV, isolate pathway spotting.
why: This integration uses all of OCC visual-genomic-linked then expands to slides with text endpoint; enables conv neural expression in both biological and molecular axes.
